title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130324:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Appendix (Regulations for the Implementation of the Personnel Regulations of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries) <Item 1, March 24, 2013>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This regulation shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 are omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Regulations) Items ① through <24> are omitted.

<25> The following portions of the Regulations for the Enforcement of the Mutual Insurance Association Act are amended:

Article 6: All items except those in paragraph 6, Article 7, paragraph 1 and 2, Article 8, paragraph 3, Article 9, paragraph 2, Article 10, all items except those in paragraph 6, and Article 11, all items except those in paragraph 6 shall be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries."

Articles 26 through 63 are omitted.
